name: service-judge
description: LLM-as-judge evaluation for AI services: scorecard, grade, and prioritized fixes — plus an autonomous improvement loop.

interface.shortDescription: Grade your AI service like a rigorous QA engineer
interface.longDescription: Runs a full LLM-as-judge evaluation of your LLM-powered service: generates a realistic question set, probes the live service, checks answers against ground truth, and scores every answer with a strong judge model. Delivers a per-question scorecard, an overall grade, and a prioritized fix list.
